items.title: Show HN: PDF to ePub Conversion Tool for Mac
items.contentSnippet:
I read a lot on e-ink readers. Lately I switched to a very small e-reader and PDFs are ~useless on it. So I vibe coded out a quick Swift Command Line Utility that uses Apple's Native PDF, Vision and Intelligence APIs to scan, format, proofread and convert PDFs into ePubs. You can build the command line function for personal use, or download and install the Release. This installs as a Quick Action for pdf files in Finder. Though I would share this since I found it to be useful.

items.title: Show HN: Fresh cleanup and reset a project after coding agent prs
items.contentSnippet:
Coding agents kept filling up my disk with stale worktrees and leaving branches behind, so I built Fresh to clean up merged branches and worktrees and switch back to the default branch after merging a PR.
Then I added support for project-specific commands so I could clean up after the agents, install dependencies, build, and run the project in one action. I was tired of remembering a different string of commands for every project.
Now for all my projects, it’s just one action: fresh.

items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: Wonderhop – A daily game: guess what most people say, or what none do
items.contentSnippet:
Hello HN!
Wonderhop is a small browser game with no account needed to play, everyday there are 4 rounds of 7 quesitons like "Name a food that a lot of people hate"
The goal depends on the mode: Either gives the answer most people would give, the one no one would give, the oldest answer or the most recent one and there's a leaderboard for the day.

Show HN: Sugabots – Group chats where your team and AI agents work together
items.contentSnippet:
Showing off Sugabots, an internal project I built at work that we've decided to open-source.
I got tired of the team just copying context between agents and Slack. So I built an internal tool for shared chats where our team and agents could work together, using our choice of models and tools.
The team is now actively maintaining and building on it to add all the features we're missing. We've shared a hosted offering with a few other teams and has proven useful for them too.
